COURT'S OR JUDGES'S ORDERS
22.06.2023 C24 No. 17 of 2023
Hon'ble Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.
Mr. C.K. Sharma, Advocate, for the
applicant.
Mr. Malay Sameer, respondent in
person.
This Transfer Application under
Section 24 of CPC, has been preferred by
the applicant who is the opposite party to
the proceedings under Section 13(1)(ia) of
the Hindu Marriage Act, which was
registered as Matrimonial Suit No. 168 of
2022, Malay Sameer Vs. Smt. Ranjana
Pathni, which stood instituted before the
Judge, Family Court, Almora on various
counts. The applicant has filed this C24
Application, praying for that the aforesaid
proceedings may be transferred to the
competent Court in District Nainital.
Initially, when the coordinate Bench
of this Court, had passed the interim order
on 06.04.2023, the parties were directed to
be called upon to appear in person, in order
to make an effort for mediation. The parties
are present in person. The respondent
husband has appeared in person and upon
being referred, the matter before the
Registrar (Protocol) the Mediator for
mediation, it is reported by the Mediator
that the mediation has failed.
On revival of the proceedings,
looking to the request made by the

applicant in her C24 Application, seeking
transfer of the proceedings on the ground,
that apart from the fact that she is having
her personal difficulties to travel Almora for
her participation in the proceedings under
Section 13 of the Hindu Marriage Act.
Apart from it, it is contended by the
learned counsel for the applicant, that there
are other proceedings too which are
pending before the competent Court at
Nainital, for example; proceedings under
Section 125 of CrPC.
Upon being asked, the respondent
husband submits that in fact, the place
where the proceedings have been going on,
that would be equidistance from her place
of abode at Betalghat. Hence, he submits
that if the request made by the applicant is
taken into consideration and if the matter is
transferred to the competent Court at
District Nainital, the respondent husband
may not be having any objection, as such.
Owing to the aforesaid statement
made by the respondent husband, the
proceedings, as instituted before the
competent Family Court at District Almora,
the same is hereby directed to be
transferred to the competent Family Court
at District Nainital.
Accordingly, C24 Application stands
allowed.
(Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.)
 22.06.2023
Mahinder/
